description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'LoanProductNotFoundException' used for signaling that a loan product with a specified identifier was not found. It extends a base exception class and provides constructors to handle various ways of specifying the missing loan product.

classes.name: LoanProductNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a loan product resource identified by ID or ExternalId was not found.

methods.name: LoanProductNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a Long ID and creates an exception indicating the loan product with this ID does not exist.

methods.name: LoanProductNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an ExternalId and creates an exception indicating the loan product with this external identifier does not exist.

methods.name: LoanProductNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a Long ID and an EmptyResultDataAccessException, for wrapping database access exceptions.

methods.name: LoanProductNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Creates an exception for a missing loan product identified by a Long ID.

methods.name: LoanProductNotFoundException(ExternalId externalId)
methods.description: Creates an exception for a missing loan product identified by an ExternalId.

methods.name: LoanProductNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Creates an exception wrapping a database access exception caused by a missing loan product.
